name: uplabs-unified
description: Plataforma unificada UPLabs - Todos los proyectos en un solo lugar

scripts.dev:projects: concurrently "npm run dev:design" "npm run dev:leads" "npm run dev:nps" "npm run dev:whapy"
scripts.build: npm run build:container && npm run build:projects
scripts.build:projects: concurrently "npm run build:design" "npm run build:leads" "npm run build:nps" "npm run build:whapy"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run --prefix container install && npm run --prefix projects/design install && npm run --prefix projects/leads install && npm run --prefix projects/nps install && npm run --prefix projects/whapy install
